dialogues.jp: ソファーに座り、ひとりテレビを眺める。
dialogues.en: I plopped down onto the sofa, and switched on the TV.
dialogues.text: I plopped down onto the sofa, and switched on the TV.

dialogues.jp:
体調を崩した音夢は、俺の作ったおかゆを食べ
て、今はもう自分の部屋で眠っている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu exhausted herself today, so she went to her room to
sleep after I gave her some hot water to drink.
dialogues.text:
Nemu exhausted herself today, so she went to her room to
sleep after I gave her some hot water to drink.

dialogues.jp: ピンポーン
dialogues.en: *Ding Dong*
dialogues.text: *Ding Dong*

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: なんだろ……？
dialogues.en: Who's that...?
dialogues.text: Who's that...?

dialogues.jp: ソファーから立ち上がり、インターホンにでる。
dialogues.en: I got up from the sofa and go to the speakerphone.
dialogues.text: I got up from the sofa and go to the speakerphone.

dialogues.speaker: Deliveryman
dialogues.jp: 『お届け物でーす』
dialogues.en: "Special Delivery."
dialogues.text: "Special Delivery."

dialogues.jp: 若い男の声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: A young man was on the other side.
dialogues.text: A young man was on the other side.

dialogues.jp: （なんの荷物だ？）
dialogues.en: "(A package?)"
dialogues.text: "(A package?)"

dialogues.jp: 受話器を置いて、玄関へと向かう。
dialogues.en: I put down the receiver, and walked to the hallway entrance.
dialogues.text: I put down the receiver, and walked to the hallway entrance.

dialogues.jp: 玄関で小包を受け取り、再びソファーに座る。
dialogues.en:
I received the package at the hallway, and returned to the
sofa.
dialogues.text:
I received the package at the hallway, and returned to the
sofa.

dialogues.jp:
差出人欄には、アルファベットの文字が並んで
いる。差出人の名前は――
dialogues.en:
The sender field was written in english alphabets. The
sender's name was--
dialogues.text:
The sender field was written in english alphabets. The
sender's name was--

dialogues.jp: Ｓａｋｕｒａ　Ｙｏｓｈｉｎｏ
dialogues.en: Ｓａｋｕｒａ Ｙｏｓｈｉｎｏ
dialogues.text: Ｓａｋｕｒａ Ｙｏｓｈｉｎｏ

dialogues.jp: 「芳乃さくら……あ、さくらか」
dialogues.en: "Yoshino Sakura...ahh, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Yoshino Sakura...ahh, Sakura."

dialogues.jp:
昔――隣に住んでいた俺の従姉。今はアメリカ
に引っ越していていないが、毎年こうやってチョ
コを送ってくる。
dialogues.en:
My old next door neighbour, and elder cousin. She's
currently living in America, but sends chocolates over every
year.
dialogues.text:
My old next door neighbour, and elder cousin. She's
currently living in America, but sends chocolates over every
year.

dialogues.jp:
国境を越えるせいか、いつも大幅に遅れて届く
けど……。
dialogues.en:
Since the countries are so far apart, large-scale gifts like
this always take a while to get here.
dialogues.text:
Since the countries are so far apart, large-scale gifts like
this always take a while to get here.

dialogues.jp: 「まったく、律儀なやつだ」
dialogues.en: "Heh, she's nothing if not faithful."
dialogues.text: "Heh, she's nothing if not faithful."

dialogues.jp: 箱を開け、中のブツを確認する。
dialogues.en: I started opening up the parcel.
dialogues.text: I started opening up the parcel.

dialogues.jp: 「なんじゃこりゃ……？」
dialogues.en: "What the hell?"
dialogues.text: "What the hell?"

dialogues.jp:
ＢＩＧな東京タワーのチョコが、箱の中に収め
られていた。
dialogues.en:
From inside the box, I pulled out a BIG piece of chocolate
shaped like the Tokyo Tower.
dialogues.text:
From inside the box, I pulled out a BIG piece of chocolate
shaped like the Tokyo Tower.

dialogues.jp:
タワーに貼り付けられたホワイトチョコの板に
は、へたくそな字で“根性”と書かれていた。
dialogues.en:
A sign made of white chocolate was stuck onto the side, with
the words "Perseverance" written on it.
dialogues.text:
A sign made of white chocolate was stuck onto the side, with
the words "Perseverance" written on it.

dialogues.jp: 「……相変わらず、訳わからんやつだ」
dialogues.en:
"...I'd never understand that girl's intentions, but that's
the norm anyway."
dialogues.text:
"...I'd never understand that girl's intentions, but that's
the norm anyway."

dialogues.jp: こんな立体物、どうやって食えってんだ？
dialogues.en: How on earth is this thing supposed to be eaten?
dialogues.text: How on earth is this thing supposed to be eaten?

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、冷やさないほうがいいだろう。余
計硬くなる。
dialogues.en: Moreover, it's too big to be stored into a refrigerator.
dialogues.text: Moreover, it's too big to be stored into a refrigerator.

dialogues.jp: さっさと食べるに限るか……。
dialogues.en: Better eat it quickly before it melts...
dialogues.text: Better eat it quickly before it melts...

dialogues.jp: 大口を開けると、先端の方からかぶりついた。
dialogues.en:
Opening my mouth wide, I take a big bite at the tip of the
chocolate tower.
dialogues.text:
Opening my mouth wide, I take a big bite at the tip of the
chocolate tower.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらからのバレンタイン◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura's Valentine◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura's Valentine◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらからチョコレートが届いた。バレンタイ
ンってやつだが、国境を越えるせいか、いつも
大幅に遅れる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's chocolate finally arrived. Due to the distance
between the two countries and the large-scale of her
presents, her Valentine's gifts always arrive late.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's chocolate finally arrived. Due to the distance
between the two countries and the large-scale of her
presents, her Valentine's gifts always arrive late.

dialogues.jp:
今年のは、何故かＢＩＧな東京タワーのチョコ
で、“根性”とか下手な文字で書かれていた。
dialogues.en:
This year, it's a BIG chocolate Tokyo Tower with a sign on
the side that reads "Perseverance".
dialogues.text:
This year, it's a BIG chocolate Tokyo Tower with a sign on
the side that reads "Perseverance".

dialogues.jp: 何なんだろうね、一体……。
dialogues.en: What the hell is this, really...
dialogues.text: What the hell is this, really...
